behaviorChanges: un-adapted session starts (goal-kickoff-prompt, the generated launcher, and the no-adapter recovery text) now offer STATE-AWARE guided onboarding with root-resolved commands (fresh repo -> `tautline init --target <root>`; interview in progress -> `init --target <root> --continue`; source adapter present but unrendered -> render-adapters then lane-start), mediated through AskUserQuestion. Nothing auto-runs; gate verbs still fail closed with improved recovery text.

the no-adapter message is split into a stable `NO_ADAPTER_SENTINEL` prefix + a swappable recovery block + a preserved footer; unmanaged-at-target output is byte-identical to before, and every consumer now matches on the sentinel prefix. No exit-code changes.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below 0.14.6 restores the single stale `init` recovery line for every un-adapted state and removes the onboarding offers; no state migration (nothing was written).
grant-gh-project-scopes is carried forward from 0.10.3 (see requiredMigrations); a lane already on 0.10.3+ needs no action.
NOT WIP-safe only for the engine-gap carry-forward; the release's own change is a display/recovery-text improvement safe for lanes in progress.
